meta.name: Rokar POS
meta.description: Rokar is a fast, offline-first billing & inventory POS for retail shops in Pakistan. Billing, udhaar (khata), stock audit, supplier tracking and reports — all on one Windows app.
meta.ogTitle: Rokar POS — Billing & Inventory for Pakistani Shops
meta.ogDescription: Offline-first POS with billing, udhaar khata, inventory, reports and thermal receipt printing. Built for small retail shops.

hero.eyebrow: Offline-first POS · Made for Pakistani shops
hero.lead: Rokar is Pakistan's fastest offline billing & inventory software built specifically for retail dukaan owners. Scan barcodes, bill in 3 seconds, track udhaar (khata), and see daily net profit — no internet needed.
hero.versionNote: Version 2.8.0 · 15 days free full trial with instant setup

features.eyebrow: Sab Kuch Ek Hi App Mein
features.lead: Rokar brings billing, stock, customer credit, and profit reports together — replacing registers, lost udhaar pages, and mental math with 100% accurate computer records.

items.title: Fast offline billing
items.desc: Bill a whole customer in under 3 seconds. Barcode scan or 2-letter search. Works fully offline without ever needing internet.

items.title: Udhaar / Khata Ledger
items.desc: Customer credit accounts with 'Kitna baqi hai' at a glance. 1-click WhatsApp balance reminders prevent lost money.

items.title: Inventory & Stock Audit
items.desc: Real-time stock deduction, low-stock warnings, and full stock audit tools to match physical shelf items with system ledger.

items.title: Thermal & A4 Receipts
items.desc: Instant printing on 58mm and 80mm thermal receipt printers, barcode label generation, and elegant A4 tax invoices.

items.title: Purchases & Suppliers
items.desc: Record purchase bills, supplier dues, return vouchers, and track incoming stock costs with complete ledger history.

items.title: Daily Profit & Reports
items.desc: Today's sales, net profit, top-selling items, hourly rush trends, and monthly P&L exportable directly to Excel.

items.title: Multi-shift Cash Drawer
items.desc: Separate morning and evening cash drawers with end-of-shift cash counting. Know kis cashier ne kitna cash jama karaya.

items.title: Cashier & Owner Roles
items.desc: Owner, Manager, Cashier permissions. Cashiers can only bill; profit figures and sensitive settings stay locked for Owner only.

items.title: WhatsApp Digital Receipts
items.desc: Send itemized digital receipts straight to customer WhatsApp in 1 click. Saves thermal paper and looks ultra professional.

items.title: Daily Cloud Backup
items.desc: Automated daily encrypted backups to your Google Drive or OneDrive. If your PC ever crashes, your data is 100% safe.

items.title: Wholesale & Retail Modes
items.desc: Retail price for walk-in customers, wholesale rate for bulk thok buyers — switch instantly at billing in one tap.

items.title: Barcode Label Generator
items.desc: Design and print your own custom barcode stickers for unbranded items directly from Rokar POS to any label printer.

faq.q: Kya Rokar POS chalane ke liye har waqt internet chahiye?
faq.a: Bilkul nahi! Rokar 100% offline software hai. Billing, inventory, khata aur reports sab aapke computer par chalte hain. Internet sirf optional cloud backup ya WhatsApp receipt bhejne ke liye chahiye.

faq.q: Mera purana data aur inventory Excel se import ho sakti hai?
faq.a: Haan, bilkul! Rokar mein 1-click Excel import feature hai. Aapke tamaam products, barcodes aur prices sirf 1 minute mein software mein load ho jate hain.

faq.q: Kya thermal printer aur barcode scanner connect ho jate hain?
faq.a: Jee haan, Pakistan mein milne wale tamaam USB, Bluetooth aur Network thermal printers (Xprinter, Black Copper, Rongta وغیرہ) aur standard barcode scanners direct plug & play hain.

faq.q: Agar computer kharab ho jaye to mera hisaab mehfooz rahega?
faq.a: Aapka poora hisaab rozana khud-ba-khud aapke Google Drive ya OneDrive par encrypted cloud backup hota hai. Naye PC par sirf backup restore karein aur sab wapas!

faq.q: Kya ek se zyada cashiers aur alag alag shifts bana sakte hain?
faq.a: Jee haan, Owner, Manager aur Cashier ke alag roles hain. Subha aur shaam ki alag shifts ka cash drawer hisaab banta hai taake koi chori ya ghalti na ho.
